name: manual_392f88
claim: While syncing a hygiene gate across repos, do not commit unrelated local edits to identity policy or cursor PR-body scripts. Dropping an allowed automation identity from a repo bot-identity list is a policy regression, not part of the gate.

decisions.notes: orama-system worktree already had dirty append-pr-body, pr-body-grant-lib, identity-policy, and two mode-only script changes. They were left unstaged so the private-range sync commits stayed limited to the gate.

rationale: orama-system worktree already had dirty append-pr-body, pr-body-grant-lib, identity-policy, and two mode-only script changes. They were left unstaged so the private-range sync commits stayed limited to the gate.
